Software Engineer – Resume & Career Assistant Platform

Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain an AI-powered Resume & Career Assistant platform. The ideal candidate will build scalable web applications, integrate AI technologies, and create tools that help users build resumes, optimize job applications, and improve their career prospects.

Responsibilities

•⁠  ⁠Develop and maintain frontend and backend features.
•⁠  ⁠Build resume creation, editing, and export functionality.
•⁠  ⁠Integrate AI services for resume analysis and job matching.
•⁠  ⁠Design and manage databases and APIs.
•⁠  ⁠Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
•⁠  ⁠Collaborate with designers, product managers, and QA teams.
•⁠  ⁠Troubleshoot bugs and implement improvements.
•⁠  ⁠Write clean, maintainable, and documented code.

Requirements

•⁠  ⁠Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
•⁠  ⁠Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
•⁠  ⁠Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
•⁠  ⁠Knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
•⁠  ⁠Experience with REST APIs and cloud platforms.
•⁠  ⁠Understanding of software development best practices.
•⁠  ⁠Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

•⁠  ⁠Experience with AI/LLM integrations.
•⁠  ⁠Knowledge of resume parsing and ATS systems.
•⁠  ⁠Experience with SaaS product development.
•⁠  ⁠Familiarity with Docker and cloud deployment.

Benefits

•⁠  ⁠Competitive salary.
•⁠  ⁠Flexible work environment.
•⁠  ⁠Career growth opportunities.
•⁠  ⁠Access to the latest AI technologies.

Job Type

Full-time

* Project Manager
* Operations Manager

The salary for a Personal Assistant at TCS can vary depending on factors such as location, experience, and qualifications. However, here are some approximate salary ranges:

* Entry-level (0-2 years of experience): ₹3.5-5 lakhs per annum
* Mid-level (2-5 years of experience): ₹5-8 lakhs per annum
* Senior-level (5-10 years of experience): ₹8-12 lakhs per annum

* Health insurance

* Paid time off
* Training and development opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements

* Work with senior executives and learn from their experiences
* Develop strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Gain exposure to various business functions and operations
* Participate in training and development programs to enhance your skills
* Contribute to the growth and success of the company

Overall, the Personal Assistant role at TCS can be a rewarding and challenging opportunity for those who are organized, communicative, and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
